task: Prevent multi-line Unilock description matching from timing out
specApproval: not obtained (autonomous correction requested by user)
behaviors: One request containing the historical 80mm and 60mm Beacon Hill Smooth Random Fossil descriptions returns both exact catalogue products within the existing 90-second matching deadline.
Catalogue colours stated as complete phrases in descriptions constrain candidates; overlapping colour names use the longest complete phrase and conflicting colours require manual review.
S or T immediately after a stated mm/cm thickness constrain Smooth or Textured catalogue finishes.
Prompt input excludes empty fields and a specification identical to the product description; cache invalidation still uses all original descriptors.
The Qwen3 4B model and inference settings, prompt instructions and 90-second timeout remain unchanged.
Existing exact-variant, confidence, duplicate-identity, side, quantity and evidence safeguards remain active.
Historical evaluation does not create live stock jobs, modify requests or catalogue records, or touch the Unilock cart.
setup: Existing bounded disposable Compose, tools and dependencies. No schema changes, new dependencies or commits.
